boundary_reference.method: Unmodified evaluator on overlapping boundary rows; warmed shard inputs vs independent full-recorded-history reference inputs; compare complete snapshot, not only signal id.

data_audit.gap_policy: Kept exactly as recorded; no fill, interpolation or replacement.
data_audit.quote_policy: MqlRates spread is bar metadata, not an evidenced contemporaneous bid/ask. No quote is invented.
data_audit.time_policy: UTC bar-open labels; evaluate each recorded M5 close; forming bars are passed through and independently checked by canonical L1.

evaluator.native_reference_schedule: Every closed H1 window change and new opportunity/C11/eligibility plan; C10 is always recomputed, never memoized.

l5_cost_source: VT recorded M5 spread_price of the last closed bar (tests/fixtures/ccfd_v100/recorded_60d/<SYM>_m5_meta.csv) + OD1011-COMMISSION binding (scripts/ccfd_sweep_retest_replay.commission_binding), the accepted source of the CCFD 1.0.0 L5 PASS on the same recorded 60d data

layout.warmup_policy: Current host windows plus the complete declared creation lookback before the oldest possible active creation bar; original capture start retained; no synthetic overlap.
